notes.title: Major Update for Vagrant Knight (v.0.3.1.0)
notes.content:
Hey all, after month of absent as I been hard at working on major update on Vagrant Knight content.
Below is brief summary on changes you see on this update.

Price Change
First thing, Vagrant Knight is now priced at $4.99 (previously is $5.99).

New Levels
There's now new 9 levels designed for Vagrant Knight, previously is 4 levels and cosmetic wise it's very
plain looking.
These new levels is big boost visually but also designed to add more obstacles.

New Enemies
I also removed some enemies as they don't fit the theme of the game.
However I also added more unique enemies which gives player more sweaty finger.

New special attacks and spells
I also added new special attacks and spells so players now have more
in arsenals at their disposal.

Finally, thanks to everyone who supported by buying Vagrant Knight.

notes.title: Welcome & Planning Forward
notes.content:
Hi all,

First off, big thank you for taking interest on this game.
This game is obviously another take on 'vampire survivors' genre
but unlike other similar games, there's more emphasize on skills and difficulties are ramped up.
Every enemy spawned need an effort from you to kill instead of casting one spell 
that incinerates all enemies on the screen.
My goal on this game is to made it challenging while maintaining roguelike elements from being repetitive/predictable.
Plans forward include:

 introducing new varieties of enemies.
Currently there's 14 unique enemies.
introducing new spells and special attacks (melee)
Currently there's 19 unique special attacks and 28 unique spells.
I will be playtesting during development and continue to 
update/tweaking existing enemies and special attacks/spells.
Add boss fight
There's no boss implemented in this game.
Every few levels, you will be facing random boss fight.
Level modification
All levels are currently square shaped with wall as boundary.
As such, playability is limited as player just need to linearly react and move to empty spaces
to avoid any enemies ahead.
Introducing level modification include making level polygonal/custom shaped or add blocking environment which pin player to the wall/restrict movement against horde of enemies.

I will be posting updates regularly (hopefully every week) on steam.

If you are curious, you can check my trello for real time Todo list.

Also please follow my twitter for frequent updates.

Thanks,
Gamester
